title: Dotfield x- kinds
description: packs/<id>/kinds.json and center/kinds.json (V2_PLAN 7.2): one row per x-<custom> node kind, the same four fields as a renderers/shapes.json row plus an optional legend label and layout hint. lib/rooms.mjs kindsFor(ctx) merges renderers/shapes.json <- every installed pack's kinds.json (installed_packs order) <- center/kinds.json <- a sketch's kinds block (later wins, whole rows) and passes the table as ctx.shapes, so the topology gate (DF_IR_KIND_UNKNOWN), the layout metrics, svg.mjs and the render gate (DF_RENDER_SHAPE_UNKNOWN) read one table. Only x- kinds may be declared: the twelve core kinds stay the engine's. A file that does not validate is reported under DF_SCHEMA_* and contributes no row.

kind.description: One x- kind. glyph2d is one of the twelve glyphs svg.mjs draws, primitive3d one of the ten primitives three.mjs instances, size_mult multiplies the glyph radius (the layout and the clearance gate measure the multiplied radius), label_anchor is the default label side. legend names the kind in the legend rail; layout_hint is advisory metadata for authoring tools (lib/layout does not read it in v2.0).

size_mult.description: Greater than zero; the 0.1 floor keeps the glyph visible and its label measurable (the validator has no exclusiveMinimum).
